subject.title: Feature: Surface cron job name / session label in /status and statusline

question: Should OpenClaw take the narrow core status-label display fix now, and should it be adopted upstream instead of waiting on the open cross-repository PR?
rationale: The source-level gap is still valid, but the issue has product-decision/no-new-fix-pr signals and a conflicting open cross-repository closing PR, so automation should not create a competing fix without maintainer direction.

options.title: Adopt a narrow core fix
options.body: Land a focused shared-status change with terminal-safe label rendering, raw-key fallback/detail, and regression coverage while leaving broader JSON attribution separate.

options.title: Wait for contributor rebase
options.body: Ask the open cross-repository PR author to rebase, address terminal-safety and current status-builder drift, and provide real behavior proof before this issue closes.

options.title: Defer to broader attribution
options.body: Keep this issue as product input for the broader usage/status attribution work, accepting that CLI/TUI status remains UUID-heavy for now.

recommendation.title: Adopt a narrow core fix
recommendation.body: Land a focused shared-status change with terminal-safe label rendering, raw-key fallback/detail, and regression coverage while leaving broader JSON attribution separate.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision crosses TUI statusline, CLI status, and session-display product boundaries where the path history shows recent work.
